name: Serahiah
title: Priest and scribe in Ezra's lineage
summary: Serahiah was a priest belonging to the high-priestly line from Aaron through Zadok. He is best known as the father of Ezra, the great scribe and priest who led the Jews back from the Babylonian exile. Serahiah is mentioned in several genealogies that connect the pre-exilic and post-exilic priestly traditions.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Ezra's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Serahiah is listed in the priestly genealogy showing Ezra's descent from Aaron through the high-priestly line.

keyEvents.title: Part of the priestly lineage in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Serahiah is mentioned in the great genealogy of Levi's descendants as part of the high-priestly line from Aaron to Jehozadak.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Hilkiah
keyEvents.description: Serahja is listed as the son of Azariah and father in the line that includes Hilkia, the priest who found the Book of the Law during King Josiah's reform.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy in the Book of Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: Serahja is mentioned in the list of priests and Levites who returned from exile, confirming the continuity of the priestly lineage.

keyEvents.title: Ezra's Authorization as Priest
keyEvents.description: Through Serahja and the priestly lineage, Ezra received his authority as a priest and scribe to teach God's law in Israel after returning from Babylon.
